nodes.label: Home / Plant Selection Screen (Beranda - Pilih Tanaman)
nodes.description: UI design screenshot of the home/plant-selection screen for the Smart Plant Disease mobile app. Features: dark green gradient header with app title 'Smart Plant Disease' and subtitle 'Deteksi Penyakit Tanaman' (Plant Disease Detection) in white text. Main content is a 2-column grid of tappable plant selection cards. Each card shows a plant photograph and Indonesian name. Plants shown: Jagung (Corn), Padi (Rice), Kentang (Potato), Tomat (Tomato), Cabai (Chili Pepper), and possibly others. Bottom navigation bar with Beranda, Deteksi, Riwayat, Profil tabs. Material Design-inspired mobile UI with green and white color scheme.

edges.note: Selecting tomato (tomat) card on the home screen navigates to the detection result screen
